0.0: Maybe if I squeeze him in like...Darn...what should I do? I can't put Oinkers into the store house. He is way too fat...Hey! You look like a strong adventurer. Can you help me?

yes.0: Yes? Thank you very much. My name is #p2060005# and I'm a monster tamer. I look after monsters and study how we can both exist peacefully in the Maple World. I want to prove that monsters can live with humans, if they don't attack them of course. That's why I show people tamed monsters. They're actually quite friendly once tamed. The tricky part is just getting them not to bite off your hand, which can be difficult, I admit.
yes.1: But people just don't like to look at them, and my work wasn't having the impact I wanted. So, I researched another way for others to view monsters as tamable creatures--by riding them. What do you think? I hope it will work!
yes.2: My studies are nearly finished. When I finish with #t4031507#, humans can travel simply by riding monsters. However, a few days ago, these weird, yet fascinating creatures broke into my home and learned of my research! I fear what may happen if the secret gets into the wrong hands--this is not for power but for peaceful coexistence of humans and monsters. I fear that if they find my lab and then my notes, they might turn the monsters even more vicious!
yes.3: So would you help me? I want you to protect Oinkers and gather #b5 #t4031507##k. Don't forget to find #b5 #t4031508##k too. Thanks--I will see that you are rewarded for your help!

no.0: You must be busy. It's ok. I'll just have to find another person to help me...

1.0: Wow! You protected Oinkers! On top of that, you brought #t4031507# and #t4031508#! Wonderful! You are a real adventurer! Thank you for helping me with this.
1.1: You've helped bring peace between humans and monsters, so I think you deserve to learn the #bMonster Riding#k skill. Finish researching  #t4031507# and you'll be able to mount monsters..

yes.0: Soon I'll finish with #t4031507#. Please come to me if you want to use Monster Riding, and help show people that both humans and monsters can co-exist and work together!

item.0: You haven't protected Oinkers from attackers--no wonder he doesn't have a scratch on him! Remember, I'll need #b5 #t4031507##k and #b5 #t4031508##k. We can't have anything missing! Please bring back everything back to me!
